title: Finite-sheet intersection as a rational matrix kernel
statement: With coefficients [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], let p:U→X be finite etale surjective, P a pro-etale locally finite free rational module, M a pro-etale locally finite free integral module and e:Ext(M)≅p^*P. There exists a pro-etale cover C of X with compact members such that, for each member, the normalized pullback of the explicitly constructed intersection N of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-lattice-intersection] is isomorphic to the kernel of the integral adjoint of an epi f:Ext(O^n)→Ext(O^m), for suitable finite n,m. This assertion gives a rational presentation, not local freeness or a rationalization isomorphism for N.

source.place: Section 6.8, coefficient localization and Lemma 6.8.13, first paragraph; agent intersection/matrix variant

proof.text: Apply the split finite-sheet image-pullback model on compact covering members. The finite-free integral localization unit is mono, so both arrows define subobjects.

Use the proved imagePullbackIsoKernel universal-property isomorphism: the intersection of two subobjects is the kernel of the second subobject map to the first quotient. Restriction of scalars preserves cokernels, so the quotient of G(i) is G(coker(i)). Transport it along the given basis coker(i)≅F(O^m). The resulting map from O^n is exactly the integral adjoint of cokernel.π(i) followed by this basis. The latter rational map is epi. KernelCompMono and the displayed equality identify the required kernel.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousLatticeIntersection_rationalModel
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj P))
    {U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X) [IsFinite p] [Etale p] [Surjective p]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U))
    (hM : ∃ D : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage U, ∀ s : D.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).mapMod _).obj M))
    (e : (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) U)).obj M ≅
      (upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P) :
    ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      CompactSpace (C.X s) ∧
      let R := condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) (C.X s)
      let T := (ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) ⋙
        Mod.comap (inv (condensedPullbackHom (integralCoeff ℓ E) (C.f s)))
      let F := Mod.extendScalars
        (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (C.X s))
      ∃ (n m : ℕ) (f : F.obj (Mod.finiteFree R n) ⟶ F.obj (Mod.finiteFree R m)),
        Epi f ∧ Nonempty
          (T.obj (latticeIntersection (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X P p M e) ≅
            kernel ((Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction
              (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (C.X s))).homEquiv _ _ f))
